notes.title: DEV NOTE 0.1.1
notes.notes:
[p][b]🚀 New Features & Content[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Advanced Kiosk Trading System[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Category-Based Item Filtering[/b]: Implemented dual-mode kiosk system with separate gear and ingredient categories[/p][p]- [b]Automatic Asset Loading[/b]: Items now load sprites and prefabs automatically from JSON data[/p][p]- [b]Enhanced Management Tools[/b]: New editor tools for seamless item management with unified interface[/p][p]- [b]Kiosk Mode System[/b]: Support for both gear and ingredient modes with runtime category settings[/p][p]- [b]Unified Data Source[/b]: Modified gear_name.cs to use kiosk.json as single data source[/p][p]- [b]Runtime Category Settings[/b]: Added showGearItems and showIngredientItems runtime settings[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Dynamic Visual & Weather Systems[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Smooth Fog Transitions[/b]: Rain now creates beautiful fog effects that transition smoothly with improved multipliers[/p][p]- [b]Dynamic Camera System[/b]: Camera responds to player movement with shake and distance adjustments[/p][p]- [b]Advanced Backpack System[/b]: 4-stage visual progression that changes based on your inventory count[/p][p]-[b]Fog-Based Text Transparency[/b]: All ingredient text adapts to weather conditions with comprehensive transparency system[/p][p]- [b]Dynamic Camera Distance[/b]: Camera distance adjustment based on movement state[/p][p]- [b]Camera Shake System[/b]: Dynamic camera shake based on player movement state[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Enhanced Vehicle & Equipment[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Jetpack Integration[/b]: New jetpack mesh and controller system with antenna and jet_rig[/p][p]- [b]Comprehensive Gear Management[/b]: Complete gear system with JSON-based data structure and error handling[/p][p]- [b]Scene Optimization[/b]: Reorganized game objects from astra_city to lunaris_city for better performance[/p][p]- [b]Radio Gear Prefab[/b]: Added radio gear prefab and updated gear management system[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]🛠️ System Improvements[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Inventory & Item Management[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Weight-Based Movement[/b]: Your run speed now decreases based on carried weight with realistic curves[/p][p]- [b]Probability-Based Spawning[/b]: Items spawn with realistic probability curves and scene-based management[/p][p]- [b]Enhanced Resource Management[/b]: Better ingredient prefabs and scene organization with improved asset handling[/p][p]- [b]New Consumable Items[/b]: Added new consumable items to food system[/p][p]- [b]Weight-Based Run Speed[/b]: Implemented weight-based run speed reduction system[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Development Tools[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Gear Management Editor[/b]: New comprehensive tool for managing all gear items with error handling[/p][p]- [b]Kiosk Management System[/b]: Unified interface for kiosk configuration with automatic asset loading[/p][p]- [b]Automatic Asset Loading[/b]: Sprites and prefabs load automatically in the editor with preview systems[/p][p]- [b]Custom Editor Tools[/b]: Added automatic prefab loading and preview to kiosk custom editor[/p][p]- [b]Sprite Fetching System[/b]: Added automatic sprite fetching to kiosk custom editor[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Data & Loading Issues[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed missing gear.json file that was causing inventory system errors[/p][p]- Corrected soy sauce sprite loading in backpack inventory[/p][p]- Resolved broken prefab references and duplicate colliders[/p][p]- Fixed missing prefab issues in astra_city scene[/p][p]- Removed debug logs from player controller and kiosk custom editor[/p][p]- Fixed sprite loading system in item_config_manager[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]System Integration[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed gear_name.cs configuration for kiosk-spawned items[/p][p]- Updated item preparation time and synchronization logic[/p][p]- Enhanced weather system integration and ingredient prefab fixes[/p][p]- Fixed hierarchy color system with multi-scene persistence[/p][p]- Configured gear_name script for kiosk-spawned items[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]💡 Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b] Player Experience[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- [b]*Dynamic Visual Feedback[/b]: Backpack now shows visual progression as you collect items with wire cable updates[/p][p]- [b]Responsive Camera[/b]: Camera adapts to your movement for better immersion with distance adjustments[/p][p]- [b]Improved Item Management[/b]: Streamlined inventory systems with better visual feedback and asset organization[/p][p]- [b]Enhanced Weather System[/b]: Improved weather system and fixed ingredient prefabs[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Development Workflow[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Editor Tools[/b]: New comprehensive tools for gear and kiosk management with automatic asset loading[/p][p]- [b]Asset Management[/b]: Automatic asset loading and preview systems with JSON-based configuration[/p][p]- [b]Scene Organization[/b]: Better scene structure and asset placement with improved hierarchy management[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]🧩 Technical Enhancements[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Data Management[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- [b]JSON-Based Configuration[/b]: New comprehensive data structures for gear and kiosk items with centralized management[/p][p]- [b]Centralized Item Management[/b]: Unified data sources for consistent item handling across all systems[/p][p]- [b]Enhanced Error Handling[/b]: Better error handling across gear management and inventory systems[/p][p]- [b]Gear Data Structure[/b]: Implemented gear management system with error handling[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]System Architecture[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Modular Design[/b]: Refactored kiosk and gear systems for improved maintainability[/p][p]- [b]Data Synchronization[/b]: Robust synchronization between editor tools and runtime with automatic asset loading[/p][p]- [b]Asset Optimization[/b]: Streamlined asset loading and management for better performance with scene-based organization[/p][p]- [b]Kiosk Structure[/b]: Established and updated kiosk_structure system[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DEV NOTE 0.1.0
notes.notes:
[p][b]🚀 New Features & Content[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]- [b]Enhanced Hovercraft Visuals:[/b] Introduced particle smoke and spotlight effects for a more dynamic and visually engaging hovercraft experience.[/p][p]- [b]Advanced Vehicle Physics:[/b] Implemented tilt logic and air float mechanics, delivering more realistic and responsive vehicle handling.[/p][p]- [b]Narrative System Integration:[/b] Added a narrative manager to support task completion and future quest tracking.[/p][p]- [b]Diary System Revamp:[/b][/p][p]- Expanded diary log entries and improved the user interface.[/p][p]- Integrated tracking for stamina, stomach, and hydration.[/p][p]- Enabled toggling of the diary log for easier progress review.[/p][p]- Added visual checkmarks for side quest completion.[/p][p]- [b]Modernized Quest & Log Visuals:[/b] Updated sprites for main quests and log lists, enhancing UI polish.[/p][p]- [b]Resource Management Overhaul:[/b][/p][p]- Enabled food spawning within the log list for interactive resource collection.[/p][p]- Introduced a comprehensive weight and backpack system, including item grabbing and carrying logic.[/p][p]- [b]Cooking & Ingredients Expansion:[/b][/p][p]- Added unique meal prefabs and new ingredient sprites.[/p][p]- Implemented a dual-tab system for streamlined ingredient management.[/p][p]- Enhanced meal component selection and synchronization logic.[/p][p]- Refined cooking device and dish management interfaces.[/p][p]- [b]Inventory & Food System Improvements:[/b][/p][p]- Added a food timer toggle and new color feedback mechanisms.[/p][p]- Introduced randomized food spawning for increased gameplay variety.[/p][p]- Improved visuals for empty slots and dishes.[/p][p]
[/p][p]---[/p][p]
[/p][p][b] 🛠️ Improvements & Tweaks[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]- [b]Vehicle Controller Optimization:[/b] Refined movement parameters for smoother, more responsive driving.[/p][p]- [b]UI/UX Enhancements:[/b][/p][p]- Resolved warnings and reorganized GUI stats for improved stability and usability.[/p][p]- Standardized string handling to uppercase for consistency.[/p][p]- Enhanced diary management and synchronization logic.[/p][p]- Improved balance logic and expanded debug logging for development efficiency.[/p][p]- [b]Cooking System Refinements:[/b][/p][p]- Centralized sprite index management via `dish.json`.[/p][p]- Improved layout and structure of cooking and dish management systems.[/p][p]- Streamlined price synchronization and removed redundant text fields.[/p][p]- Enhanced ingredient comparison and meal selection logic.[/p][p]- [b]Player Experience Upgrades:[/b][/p][p]- Prevented unintended player movement during cooking device interactions.[/p][p]- Improved save game system and diary log logic.[/p][p]- Added ESC key support for rapid menu access.[/p][p]- Expanded diary log parameters for comprehensive quest tracking.[/p][p]- Enhanced save game state tool and debug logic.[/p][p]- [b]Visual & Shader Updates:[/b] Introduced new shaders for rounded corners and broader visual effects.[/p][p]
[/p][p]---[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]- Corrected air vehicle physics for more authentic movement.[/p][p]- Removed broken FBX references and duplicate colliders.[/p][p]- Fixed issues with food spawning and player stat updates.[/p][p]- Addressed GUI activation bugs affecting player abilities.[/p][p]- Improved data parsing and mock data handling in diary logs.[/p][p]- Resolved meal component selection and velocity reset issues.[/p][p]- Fixed camera angle inconsistencies and object naming.[/p][p]
[/p][p]---[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]💡 Quality of Life[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]- Enabled ESC key functionality during GUI interactions.[/p][p]- Streamlined cook-via-GUI processes for smoother gameplay.[/p][p]- Enhanced diary log with additional quest and meal tracking parameters.[/p][p]- Improved save game state management and debug tools.[/p][p]- Added new shaders for improved visual aesthetics.[/p][p]
[/p][p]---[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]🧩 Technical & Backend Enhancements[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]- [b]Probability-Based Item Spawning:[/b] Developed a weighted system for item spawning, including scene-based management and inspector dropdowns.[/p][p]- [b]Centralized Item Effect System:[/b] Improved scene loading/unloading and inventory error handling.[/p][p]- [b]Refactored Codebase:[/b] Enhanced maintainability and modularity across inventory, diary, and cooking systems.[/p][p]- [b]Expanded Logging & Debugging:[/b] Added comprehensive debug logs and notification systems for easier development and testing.[/p][p]
[/p][p]---[/p]
